name: land-acquisition-predictive-platform
description: Land acquisition delay prediction and early warning platform

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ml
scripts.test:ml: cd ml && PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m pytest tests -q
scripts.test:ml:stdlib: cd ml && PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ml && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit && npm --prefix frontend audit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm run test
